outcome: Make the invocation's declared working directory actually reach the child process, so a Provider that is not told the workspace on its command line does not run in whatever directory the Runner happened to be started from.
non_goals: Do not remove a command-line directory flag that the CLI's own help declares
Do not treat the mount namespace as a substitute for pointing the child at its workspace
Do not widen what the child may reach in order to make the directory take effect

transitions.reason: the adapter work measured that the invocation's WorkingDirectory is set by the adapter and read by nobody: the process supervisor never assigns the child's directory and the supervised invocation runner never reads the field, so for the two Providers whose command line carries a directory flag the flag is the only thing that tells the child where it is, and for the representative Provider, whose command line carries no path at all, the child runs in the directory the Runner was started from rather than the Increment's workspace
